integrity: Analytical proof rests on established branching and conditional transition-measure convergence; finite numerical checks are corroboration only. Publication priority is not independently certified.
limitations: The exact formula assumes identity localization and uniform random-transposition Hamiltonian and jump operators. The large-size result is for one standard-character mode, pointwise in scaled time, not total-variation cutoff or full spectral convergence. The motivating original full preprint was not retrieved, though the primary author thesis technical treatment was inspected.
title: A Plancherel–Bessel crossover for the standard mode of quantum random-transposition walks
